Gwalior wife accused of demanding money, threatening husband

In Gwalior, a woman is accused by her husband of demanding ₹5 lakh and threatening to pack him in a blue drum, just two and a half months after their wedding. The incident reportedly occurred after the marriage on April 14. The wife has allegedly issued open challenges regarding these demands.
